name: San Aurie
desc:
San Aurie is an open-world roleplay simulator that mixes emergency services, criminal, and civilian life.

👮 Catch criminals and respond to emergencies.
🏁 Race players, play mini golf, or hit the arcade.
💎 Rob houses, steal cars, or stage heists.
🏠 Drive cars and bikes, customize homes, sail boats, and raise pets.
🔥 Tackle fires, rescue people, tow cars, or deliver goods and food.

Directed by EmesOfficial
